summary: Observer and subscription detail admission checks snapshot metadata and declaration kinds before decoding.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or retention change.

compatibility.detail: Only matched observer/subscription detail GET and HEAD routes defer middleware snapshot creation until the guarded same-cut reader; authentication and response-extension envelopes remain in place. Keys and host metadata retain their 4 KiB cap, cumulative source/metadata including kind eligibility and raw/fallback candidates retains 256 KiB, and rendered item plus snapshot retains 512 KiB. Oversized wrong-kind declarations return non-retryable projection-detail-too-large (HTTP 422) without candidate/list fallback; malformed kind types/UTF-8 and invalid latest snapshot timestamps return projection-detail-invalid-source (HTTP 422) before formatting. Ordinary raw-ID-first/prefixed fallback, wrong-kind/missing 404, stop and scope behavior are preserved. Other routes retain their admission snapshots.

downtime.detail: No restart or interruption beyond ordinary deployment.

recovery.detail: No writer, checkpoint or rollback changes; existing source data is preserved.
